pages.text:
Terms and Conditions
Extra Lunch Charges:
Extra lunch will be charged at USD 75 per person.
Family tent supplement:
A family tent supplement of $750 per night is chargeable for guests staying in the family tent. The family tent will be charged based on the occupancy of the
tent, and the family tent supplement added to derive its overall cost.
Child Policy:
Children between 4-12 years will be charged 50% of adult sharing rate
Cancellation Policy:
Non-refundable 30% deposit required to confirm the booking 14 days after confirmation
100 % Payment of the total Invoice is required 60 days to the date of arrival for high and peak season
100 % Payment of the total Invoice is required 30 days to the date of arrival for low season
Any cancellation 60 days to your date of arrival leads to 65% refund of the total invoice.
Any cancellation 45 Days to your date of arrival leads to 45 % refund of the total invoice.
Any cancellation 30 days to your date of arrival leads to 25% refund of the total invoice.
No refund for any cancellation below 30 days
(Consult the camp for credit on no refund bookings)
General Contract Terms:
This agreement is valid for the year 2027 and it must be renewed annually for the following years
These rates are confidential and cannot be made available to a 3rd party through internet sites, emails or any form of publishing.
A tour leader of a group pays 75% of the contracted rates in mid and high season.
Travel Agents on FAM trip pays 30% of the contracted rates unless invited or agreed with the ownership of Lalashe Maasai Mara
Check in on arrival date is from 12 pm and check out is at 10:00 am
Should government alter rates the camp will negotiate the rates with the contracted agents.
The hotel reserves the right of admission, the rooms are subject to availability
Bush/outdoor activities such as bush dinner, bush breakfast, sundowner and walking safari are weather permitting.
